function Cascade.new(gui,name,title)
 gui.IgnoreGuiInset=false gui.ScreenInsets=Enum.ScreenInsets.CoreUISafeInsets

 local backdrop=Instance.new("Frame") backdrop.Name=name backdrop.BackgroundTransparency=1 backdrop.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1) backdrop.Visible=false backdrop.Parent=gui

 local heading=Theme.Text(panel,"Title",title,30,22)
 local self=setmetatable({Backdrop=backdrop,Panel=panel,Heading=heading,Panes={},Stack={}},Cascade)
 self:AddPane("RootPane",title)
 workspace.CurrentCamera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(function() self:Resize(false) end)
 player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("SettingMenuScale"):Connect(function() self:Resize(false) end)

function Cascade:AddPane(id,title)

 local back=Instance.new("TextButton") back.Name="Back" back.Text="‹  "..title back.TextSize=15 back.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left back.Size=UDim2.new(1,-16,0,36) back.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(8,8) back.Parent=f Theme.Button(back)
 local list=Instance.new("ScrollingFrame") list.Name="List" list.BackgroundTransparency=1 list.BorderSizePixel=0 list.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(10,52) list.Size=UDim2.new(1,-20,1,-62) list.ScrollBarThickness=3 list.ScrollBarImageColor3=Theme.Colors.Muted list.CanvasSize=UDim2.new() list.AutomaticCanvasSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.Y list.Parent=f
 local layout=Instance.new("UIListLayout") layout.Padding=UDim.new(0,7) layout.SortOrder=Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder layout.Parent=list
 self.Panes[id]={Frame=f,List=list,Back=back}
 Nav:Connect(back,function() local at=table.find(self.Stack,id) if at and at>1 then local previous={} for i=1,at-1 do previous[i]=self.Stack[i] end self:Push(previous) elseif self.OnClose then self.OnClose() end end)

function Cascade:Button(id,name,text,callback,height)

 local b=Instance.new("TextButton") b.Name=name b.Text="  "..text b.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left b.TextWrapped=true b.TextSize=15 b.Size=UDim2.new(1,-4,0,height or 46) b.Parent=list Theme.Button(b)

 if Icons.Roles[name]then pad.PaddingLeft=UDim.new(0,42)local image=Icons.Image(b,name,22,Theme.Colors.Text)if image then image.Position=UDim2.new(0,-30,.5,-11)end end

function Cascade:Info(id,name,text,height)
 local t=Theme.Text(self.Panes[id].List,name,text,height or 68,14) Nav:Register(t,function() end) return t
end
function Cascade:Push(ids)
 self.Stack=ids self:Resize(true)
 task.delay(.04,function() if self.Backdrop.Visible then local p=self.Panes[ids[#ids]] if p then local target=p.Back for _,v in p.List:GetChildren() do if v:IsA("TextButton") then target=v break end end Nav:Focus(target) end end end)
end
function Cascade:SetOpen(on)
 self.Backdrop.Visible=on
 if on then if #self.Stack==0 then self.Stack={"RootPane"} end self:Resize(true) end
end
function Cascade:Resize(animate)
 local v=self.Backdrop.AbsoluteSize if v.X<200 or v.Y<150 then v=workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize end
 v=Theme.MenuBounds(v)
 local w=math.min(1120,v.X-32) local h=math.min(660,v.Y-40) self.Panel.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(w,h)
 local scale=player:GetAttribute("SettingMenuScale") or 1
 local modifier=self.Panel:FindFirstChild("PreferenceScale") or Instance.new("UIScale") modifier.Name="PreferenceScale" modifier.Scale=scale*Theme.MobileFactor() modifier.Parent=self.Panel
 w=math.min(1120,(v.X-24)/scale) h=math.min(660,(v.Y-20)/scale) self.Panel.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(w,h)
 local narrow=w<720
 local n=#self.Stack self.Panel:SetAttribute("CascadeDepth",n) local step=218
 if step*(n-1)+330>w then step=math.max(28,(w-math.min(330,w-(n-1)*28))/math.max(1,n-1)) end
 for _,p in self.Panes do p.Frame.Visible=false end
 for i,id in self.Stack do
  local p=self.Panes[id] local x=(i-1)*step local target=UDim2.fromOffset(x,38+(i-1)*6)
  p.Frame.Visible=not narrow or i==n if narrow then x=0 target=UDim2.fromOffset(0,38) end p.Frame.ZIndex=i p.Frame.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(narrow and w or n==1 and math.min(w,310) or i==n and w-x or step-8,h-76-(i-1)*6)
  Theme.CascadeDepth(p.Frame,n-i,animate and not Theme.ReducedMotion())
  for _,b in p.List:GetChildren() do if b:IsA("TextButton") then b.TextWrapped=i==n b.TextTruncate=i==n and Enum.TextTruncate.None or Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd end end
  if id=="RootPane" then
   p.Back.Visible=false p.List.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(10,10) p.List.Size=UDim2.new(1,-20,1,-20)
   local buttons={} for _,v in p.List:GetChildren() do if v:IsA("TextButton") then table.insert(buttons,v) end end
   for _,b in buttons do b.Size=UDim2.new(1,-4,0,math.clamp((p.Frame.Size.Y.Offset-20-math.max(0,#buttons-1)*7)/math.max(1,#buttons),46,58)) end
  end
  if animate and not Theme.ReducedMotion() then p.Frame.Position=target+UDim2.fromOffset(14,0) Tween:Create(p.Frame,TweenInfo.new(.18,Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,Enum.EasingDirection.Out),{Position=target}):Play() else p.Frame.Position=target end
 end
end
return Cascade

local Playlist={}
local player=game.Players.LocalPlayer
local Scope=require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("ModeScope"))
local Settings=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.ExperienceSettings)
local Catalog=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Crossgrounds.LobbyMusicCatalog)
local changed=Instance.new("BindableEvent") Playlist.Changed=changed.Event
Playlist.Tracks={} Playlist.Paused=false Playlist.Shuffle=false Playlist.Index=1 Playlist.State="Preparando"
for _,track in Catalog do local copy=table.clone(track) copy.enabled=track.enabled~=false table.insert(Playlist.Tracks,copy) end
local sound local retired={} local failed={} local loadingSince local lastAllowed
local function allowed() return Scope:IsHub() and not player:GetAttribute("InArena") and not player:GetAttribute("ArenaPlaying") end
local function emit()
 script:SetAttribute("CurrentTrack",Playlist.Tracks[Playlist.Index] and Playlist.Tracks[Playlist.Index].id)
 script:SetAttribute("PlaybackState",Playlist.State) changed:Fire()
end
function Playlist:Snapshot()
 return {tracks=self.Tracks,index=self.Index,paused=self.Paused,shuffle=self.Shuffle,state=self.State,active=allowed()}
end
function Playlist:Select(id,automatic)
 local index for i,t in self.Tracks do if t.id==id then index=i break end end
 if not index then return false end
 -- Listening to a disabled candidate is a preview; inclusion stays explicit.
 self.Index=index
 if not automatic then self.Paused=false failed[id]=nil end
 if sound then table.insert(retired,{sound=sound,started=os.clock()}) end
 sound=Instance.new("Sound") sound.Name="CrossgroundsLobbyTrack" sound.SoundId=self.Tracks[index].soundId sound.Volume=0 sound.Looped=false sound.Parent=game.SoundService self.Sound=sound loadingSince=nil
 local voice=sound
 sound.Ended:Connect(function() if self.Sound==voice then self:Next(1,true) end end)
 self.State=allowed() and "Carregando" or "Pausada durante a partida" emit()
 return true
end
function Playlist:Next(step,automatic)
 local options={}
 for offset=1,#self.Tracks do
  local i=(self.Index-1+(step or 1)*offset)%#self.Tracks+1 local t=self.Tracks[i]
  if t.enabled and (not automatic or not failed[t.id]) then table.insert(options,i) end
 end
 if #options==0 then self.Paused=true self.State="Nenhuma faixa disponível. Selecione uma faixa para tentar novamente." emit() return false end
 local index=options[1]
 if self.Shuffle and (step or 1)>0 and #options>1 then
  local choices={} for _,i in options do if i~=self.Index then table.insert(choices,i) end end
  index=choices[math.random(1,#choices)]
 end
 return self:Select(self.Tracks[index].id,automatic)
end
function Playlist:TogglePause()
 self.Paused=not self.Paused
 if not self.Paused then local track=self.Tracks[self.Index] if track then failed[track.id]=nil end end
 emit()
end
function Playlist:ToggleShuffle() self.Shuffle=not self.Shuffle emit() end
function Playlist:ToggleTrack(id)
 for _,track in self.Tracks do if track.id==id then
  local count=0 for _,t in self.Tracks do if t.enabled then count+=1 end end
  if track.enabled and count<=1 then return false,"Mantenha ao menos uma faixa na playlist." end
  track.enabled=not track.enabled
  if not track.enabled and self.Tracks[self.Index]==track then self:Next(1,false) end
  emit() return true
 end end
 return false
end
function Playlist:Move(id,direction)
 local current=self.Tracks[self.Index].id
 for i,t in self.Tracks do if t.id==id then
  local target=math.clamp(i+direction,1,#self.Tracks)
  table.remove(self.Tracks,i) table.insert(self.Tracks,target,t) break
 end end
 for i,t in self.Tracks do if t.id==current then self.Index=i end end emit()
end
function Playlist:Start()
 if self.Started then return end self.Started=true
 local legacy=game.SoundService:FindFirstChild("LocalMenuMusic") if legacy then legacy:Stop() end
 self:Select(self.Tracks[self.Index].id,true)
 game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
  local active=allowed()
  local volume=player:GetAttribute("SettingMenuVolume")
  if volume==nil then volume=Settings.Rules.MenuVolume.Default end
  local goal=active and not self.Paused and volume or 0
  for i=#retired,1,-1 do
   local old=retired[i] old.sound.Volume*=math.exp(-dt*8)
   if os.clock()-old.started>.8 then old.sound:Destroy() table.remove(retired,i) end
  end
  if sound then
   sound.Volume+=(goal-sound.Volume)*(1-math.exp(-dt*6))
   if goal>0 then
    if not sound.IsPlaying then sound:Resume() if not sound.IsPlaying then sound:Play() end end
    loadingSince=loadingSince or os.clock()
    if sound.IsLoaded and sound.TimeLength>0 then
     if self.State~="Tocando" then self.State="Tocando" emit() end
    elseif os.clock()-loadingSince>12 then
     failed[self.Tracks[self.Index].id]=true
     self:Next(1,true)
    end
   elseif sound.Volume<.002 then
    sound.Volume=0 if sound.IsPlaying then sound:Pause() end
    local state=not active and "Pausada durante a partida" or self.Paused and "Pausada" or "Volume em zero"
    if self.State~=state then self.State=state emit() end
   end
  end
  if lastAllowed~=active then lastAllowed=active emit() end
 end)
end
return Playlist
